title: Entropy-Regularized Process Reward Model
authors_zh: Hanning Zhang、Pengcheng Wang、Shizhe Diao、Yong Lin、Rui Pan、Hanze Dong、Dylan Zhang、Pavlo Molchanov、Tong Zhang（伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校、多伦多大学、英伟达、普林斯顿大学、Salesforce Research）
paper_type_zh: 熵正则化过程标签构造、奖励建模与策略选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合研究如何把轨迹补全结果转化为步骤奖励，以及奖励模型如何进一步过滤训练推理链的读者。
one_line: ER-PRM derives process labels from reference-policy completion rollouts under a KL-consistent entropy formulation, then uses them to train and apply a math reward model.
ER-PRM 在与 KL 正则化一致的熵框架下，从参考策略的补全轨迹推导过程标签，再用其训练并应用数学奖励模型。
why: It changes the aggregation rule that turns verified future completions into process-label targets, linking reward construction directly to the KL-regularized optimization objective.
inclusion_reason: It converts programmatically checked rollout outcomes into entropy-regularized step labels and uses them for reward-model training and data selection.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Process reward models need a value for every intermediate reasoning step, yet direct human labels are expensive. Automatic rollout labeling is cheaper, but common step scores are calculated under an ordinary MDP while the downstream language-model optimization normally constrains policy drift with a KL term relative to a reference model.

ER-PRM asks how to turn terminally verified rollout outcomes into step labels that match that KL-regularized objective. It derives an entropy-regularized partial reward from completion trajectories sampled by the initial policy, then trains a process reward model that can rank candidate solutions and select rationales for further policy training.

过程奖励模型需要为每个中间推理步骤提供数值，但直接人工标注成本高。自动轨迹展开标注更便宜，不过常见的步骤分数是在普通 MDP 下计算，而下游语言模型优化通常用相对于参考模型的 KL 项限制策略漂移。

ER-PRM 询问，如何把终点可验证的补全轨迹结果转化为与该 KL 正则化目标一致的步骤标签。它从初始策略采样的补全轨迹中推导熵正则化的部分奖励，再训练过程奖励模型，用于排序候选解答并为后续策略训练选择推理链。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ER-PRM replaces a simple average of correct future completions with an entropy-controlled log-sum-exp aggregation. The coefficient eta determines how strongly high-reward completions influence a partial step: small values approach conventional soft labels, while very large values approach hard labels.

The paper's central claim is that the step reward can be calculated from the initial reference policy rather than an unknown optimal policy. Thus the data recipe can construct process supervision before policy optimization, while retaining a mathematical connection between the labels and the KL-regularized objective later used to improve the policy.

ER-PRM 用受熵控制的对数和指数聚合替代对未来正确补全的简单平均。系数 eta 决定高奖励补全对部分步骤的影响强度：较小的值接近传统软标签，而非常大的值接近硬标签。

论文的中心主张是，步骤奖励可由初始参考策略计算，而不需要未知的最优策略。因此该数据配方能在策略优化前构造过程监督，同时保留标签与之后改善策略所用 KL 正则化目标之间的数学联系。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each math problem, the generator samples 15 stepwise solutions. For every partial step, a completer produces 16 continuations and each continuation receives one if its final answer is correct and zero otherwise. ER-PRM applies its entropy-regularized formula to these outcomes, yielding one continuous reward label per step; it reports about 260K examples and 1.5 million step labels for each source policy.

Llama-3.1-8B learns to predict a special positive token after every step, using cross-entropy and the generated labels. Candidate solutions are ranked by their lowest step score in best-of-N. For policy improvement, 16 answers per question are ranked by the PRM, the top rationale is retained, and rejection-sampling fine-tuning uses MATH plus 12,500 OpenMathInstruct-2 questions.

对于每道数学题，生成器采样 15 条分步骤解答。对于每个部分步骤，补全器生成 16 条后续轨迹；若后续轨迹的最终答案正确则得一分，否则得零分。ER-PRM 将其熵正则化公式应用于这些结果，为每一步产生一个连续奖励标签；它为每个来源策略报告约 26 万个样例和 150 万个步骤标签。

Llama-3.1-8B 使用交叉熵和生成标签，学习在每个步骤后预测一个特殊的正向词元。在最佳 N 选一中，候选解答按其最低步骤分数排序。为改进策略，每题的 16 个答案由过程奖励模型排序，最高的推理链被保留，而拒绝采样微调使用 MATH 加上 12,500 个 OpenMathInstruct-2 问题。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
With Mistral-MetaMath-7B as generator and Llama-3.1-8B reward models, ER-PRM reaches 89.5 on GSM8K and 41.3 on MATH500 at best-of-64. The corresponding soft-label PRM reaches 88.9 and 39.7, the hard-label PRM 89.1 and 40.1, and the outcome reward model 88.1 and 39.3. The reported margin is larger on the harder MATH500 setting.

In rejection-sampling fine-tuning, Mistral-MetaMath-7B rises from 77.9 to 79.7 on GSM8K and from 28.6 to 32.5 on MATH; DeepSeek-Math-7B-Instruct rises from 82.0 to 83.4 and from 42.8 to 44.7. The paper also shows that performance changes with eta and can decline at larger candidate counts because reward hacking becomes visible.

以 Mistral-MetaMath-7B 为生成器、以 Llama-3.1-8B 为奖励模型时，ER-PRM 在最佳 64 选一中于 GSM8K 达到 89.5、于 MATH500 达到 41.3。相应的软标签过程奖励模型达到 88.9 和 39.7，硬标签过程奖励模型达到 89.1 和 40.1，结果奖励模型达到 88.1 和 39.3。报告的优势在更难的 MATH500 设置上更大。

在拒绝采样微调中，Mistral-MetaMath-7B 在 GSM8K 上从 77.9 升至 79.7，在 MATH 上从 28.6 升至 32.5；DeepSeek-Math-7B-Instruct 从 82.0 升至 83.4，从 42.8 升至 44.7。论文还表明性能随 eta 改变，并且当候选数量更大时，因奖励黑客行为变得可见，性能可能下降。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier automatic process labels commonly estimate the fraction of rollouts that end correctly, then use that quantity as a soft or thresholded hard target. ER-PRM changes the target-construction rule itself: it exponentially reweights verified futures before aggregation so that the label corresponds to the entropy-regularized control formulation rather than a plain success frequency.

The contribution is therefore not only another reward-model architecture. It makes the reference policy, the number of completions, the terminal checker, eta, and the aggregation formula explicit properties of the training record. Those choices determine what a future policy is encouraged to preserve or prefer when the resulting reward model filters rationales.

较早的自动过程标签通常估计最终正确的轨迹比例，再把该数值作为软目标或阈值化的硬目标。ER-PRM 改变了目标构造规则本身：它在聚合前对已验证的未来轨迹做指数重加权，使标签对应于熵正则化控制表述，而不是普通成功频率。

因此，该贡献不仅是另一种奖励模型架构。它把参考策略、补全数量、终点检查器、eta 和聚合公式都变成训练记录的明确属性。这些选择决定了当得到的奖励模型过滤推理链时，未来策略被鼓励保留或偏好什么。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method is rollout-intensive, so its 16 continuations for every partial step create substantial construction cost. Eta is task-sensitive, large best-of-N budgets reveal reward hacking, and the authors note overfitting risk, especially with DeepSeek-Math-7B-Instruct. The evidence is mathematics-only; it does not establish that the aggregation rule transfers to domains without reliable final-answer checking.
该方法高度依赖轨迹展开，因此每个部分步骤的 16 条补全会造成显著构造成本。Eta 对任务敏感，较大的最佳 N 选一预算会暴露奖励黑客行为，作者还指出过拟合风险，特别是在 DeepSeek-Math-7B-Instruct 上。证据只限于数学；它没有证明该聚合规则能迁移到缺乏可靠最终答案检查的领域。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This is a useful implementation reference when a project has a cheap terminal checker but needs step-level reward targets. The released 273K-row dataset pairs reasoning text with reward sequences, and the code exposes the construction and training path. A reproducer should preserve the source policy, rollout budget, answer normalizer, eta, and aggregation rule, because changing any of these changes the meaning of the label rather than merely its scale.
当项目拥有廉价的终点检查器、却需要步骤级奖励目标时，这是一份有用的实现参考。发布的 27.3 万行数据集将推理文本与奖励序列配对，代码公开了构造和训练路径。复现者应保留来源策略、轨迹展开预算、答案归一化器、eta 和聚合规则，因为改变其中任何一项都会改变标签的含义，而不只是改变其尺度。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the contribution as a label-semantics paper first and a reward-model paper second. Check the derivation against the implemented terminal checker, then compare soft labels, hard labels, and different eta values on the target task. The most important audit is whether PRM ranking remains correlated with true correctness as rollout count and policy strength increase; the paper itself shows that this relationship can weaken under larger budgets or distribution shift.
应先把该贡献作为标签语义论文阅读，其次才是奖励模型论文。先核对推导与实现的终点检查器是否一致，再在目标任务上比较软标签、硬标签和不同 eta 值。最重要的审计是：当轨迹展开数量和策略强度增加时，过程奖励模型排序是否仍与真实正确性相关；论文自身表明，在更大预算或分布转移下，这种关系可能减弱。
